name: addons
description: UNVERIFIED FIRST DRAFT -- blind-authored from a plain-language description only, never run against real hardware. Login into the app, close any post-login notification dialogs, view the Add-ons screen, then log out. Steps 1-7 (dismiss system dialog through submit) are copied from the already-proven test-cases/login.json sequence (bugs 18-23, closed out end to end on real BrowserStack hardware for both platforms); steps 8+ (notifications, Add-ons, logout) are new guesses about this app's UI and have NOT been confirmed against a real screen. Expect this file to need the same bug-by-bug correction login.json did -- run it once via PHOENIX_BATCH_MODES=test-case, PHOENIX_TEST_CASE_FILE=test-cases/addons.json, and report back whatever the log/report actually shows so the guessed steps can be fixed from real evidence, not another guess.

steps.instruction: tap the Allow button to dismiss a system permission dialog
tap the LOGIN button on the home screen to open the login form
type the phone number into the phone/account number field
tap the PASSWORD tab to switch the form into password-entry mode
tap the password field to focus it
type the password into the password field
tap the LOGIN button to submit the login form
tap the close or X button to dismiss a post-login notification popup
steps.note: GUESS: this app may show one or more notification/promo dialogs right after a successful login (separate from the pre-login system permission dialog in step 1). Repeated below in case more than one stacks up -- the real count/wording needs a live run to confirm.

steps.instruction: tap the close or X button to dismiss a second post-login notification popup
steps.note: GUESS: same as the step above, for a possible second stacked dialog. Delete this step once a real run shows how many (if any) actually appear.

steps.instruction: tap the Add-ons tab or menu item
steps.note: GUESS: exact label/position unconfirmed -- docs/REAL_DEVICE_BATCH_TESTING.md's own test-case example already guesses "tap the Add-ons tab", reused here, but it has never been run against this app's real screen either.

steps.instruction: tap the Profile or Account menu to find the logout option
steps.note: GUESS: logout may be directly visible on the Add-ons/home screen, or may require first opening a Profile/Account/More menu -- unconfirmed. Marked optional so a run where logout is already visible doesn't fail here.

steps.instruction: tap the LOGOUT or Log Out button to sign out of the app
